title: Trebek!
tagline: TREBEK! is reverse Jeopardy! with an AI twist. Instead of guessing the answer, players are given the answer and must create a prompt that generates that answer exactly, word for word.
description:
Trebek! gives an answer and contestants must find a prompt that gives the same answer. Identical to Jeopardy, the game has a board of categories with increasing complexity as columns descend. The audience should see the faces of contestants while they work and the llm output. Pacing throughout with judges' commentary and audience replies between rounds and questions.
---------------------------
|       JeopardyGPT                    |
|--------------------------|
|    people |   places |   things |
|--------|--------|--------|
|      10      |    10       |      10      |
|--------|--------|--------|
|     100    |    100     |      100   |
|--------|--------|--------|
|  500      |  500      |  500      |
----------------------------
i.e. Answer: Elon Musk / Correct prompt: CEO of Tesla
Final round will give a new topic, then contestants wager an amount of points they have, then the answer is given. They have 60 seconds to get the prompt.

3 rounds (2 normal and the final)

3 contestants

Money from sponsors

Daily Doubles (Randomness)

System prompt is public. Models are private/random


## Rules:


No text manipulation to derive answer

no mathematical manipulation

Audience votes on any split judgement
